text: Too many women waste time dating the wrong men, so I made a list of the top men you want to avoid in 2026 coming from a man who is married. Top men to avoid in 2026 coming from a man who is married? How is that related to this topic? Even if he said coming from a man who is homosexual, it would make more sense. Also, for me, it is a bit weird when a man gives advice to women on which men to date. How do you know that? I personally don't think I'm well-suited to give such advice. But here, I will try to give my opinion based on some common sense. I think we're done here. There is no man left to date, ladies. How is watching adult content and cheating connected? Especially if a guy is single. Now, I would understand if he would say if the guy has porn addiction or if he still watches a lot of it when you are dating. But right away, very weird point. Well, ladies, I think you have no chances but to be a lesbian if you follow this guy's advice. What is wrong with video games? Now, again, if the guy has video games addiction and the only thing he does is play 24-7, then that is bad. But if you play video games to relax from time to time or to spend some time with your bodies, there's nothing wrong with that. Well, again, is smoking bad for your health? Yes, it is. Better be rich and healthy than poor and sick. But if the only problem is that he's a smoker but other than that he's a great guy, ladies, it is fine. If he's overweight and says, I can get into shape anytime I want, blocked. Again, how overweight? What percentage of body fat we are talking here? Yes, being overweight is not good for your health either. But what if he's a bit overweight? He still does sports, takes care of himself, but do not really watch his diet. Can he change food from time to time or have a drink occasionally? Or he's bulking to get bigger? How is that bad? If his friend group is full of lustful men and cheaters, gone, cut. Probably the first decent point. Person's social circle can tell you a lot about the person himself. If he has questionable circle, chances are he is like that too. If he avoids hard conversations, gone immediately. Need more details here as well. But yes, in a relationship it is good if you can talk about the issues. If he goes on his phone at dinner, he can't have a conversation with you, gone. Again, depends. If he is with you and on the phone all the time, yes, red flag. If he is with you but occasionally he needs to answer a call or text because it is work or family matter, then it is fine. If he doesn't have a job, let that one sink in for a second. If he doesn't have a job and is not even looking for it, yes, very bad. Overall, people who never work in their lives or do not want to work are pretty bad partners who lack thankfulness as they do not know how difficult can it be to earn money. If you say you're waiting till marriage and he says it's just one time, no, blocked, gone, cut. Is he talking about sex here? Well, not to sleep until marriage is weird overall. Sex is an essential part of any relationship. Going into a relationship or marriage without knowing how sexually compatible you are is like playing a Russian roulette. Last one. If he blames his past parents and ex for how he acts, if he is reactive, gone immediately, and bonus, if he has no job, I had to say that one again because a lot of you guys do not have standards, my goodness, thank me later. Okay, not having an accountability and blaming other people is a bad sign. Overall, this is a very weird video. I probably only agreed with two or three of his points. Others were either outright ridiculous or dependent on the context. Like, man, you could sit down, take your time, and write down a nice list, and you came up with this? Just from the top of my head, I can't come up with more reasons not to date a man as a woman. He's a cheater, he has no empathy, he's not grateful, he treats you badly, he compares you to other girls, he goes out to parties without you, and so on and so forth. Like, it's not that hard. Well, ladies, anyways, I hope you have other influencers who actually give you decent advice.
